neurons offline — the 1M network runs while he is awake when the GPU is on
Simulated spiking neurons (1M on GPU / 20k on CPU) inside the real wiring of one person's brain; each dot stands for a sampled model neuron; a model, not a mind.
Shapes are real reconstructed neurons from public databases and are illustrative: the simulated network uses point neurons (no dendrites are simulated). Pulses are slowed down to be visible.
